description: Change a giveaway before it's drawn. Changing its dates, draw, prizes, rules or bonus entries clears its approval and returns it to draft; pause a live giveaway first. Headline, description, image and colour can change any time.

closesAt.description: When entries close, as an ISO 8601 time. Must be after opensAt.

drawMethod.description: single: one winner. multiple: equal winners. placed: 1st, 2nd, 3rd…

entryPage.description: The hosted entry page's headline, description, image, brand colour and bonuses.

url.description: Where the follow or visit action sends people.

bonusActions.description: Bonus entries on offer: referral, share, follow and visit. Pro and up.

giveawayId.description: Giveaway ID. It is also the giveaway's campaign ID for approval and status.

language.description: The language the entry page, results page and site banner speak to entrants: en or es.

name.description: The giveaway's name, shown as its title.

opensAt.description: When entries open, as an ISO 8601 time.

prizes.description: One prize per place for placed draws; otherwise the first prize goes to every winner.

perkId.description: A perk from this brand to give the winner of this place.

rules.description: The official rules. A person approves them before the giveaway goes live.

fields.description: The official rules generator's operator fields: sponsor, eligibility and so on.

timezone.description: The time zone the official rules and dashboard use, e.g. America/New_York.

name: update_giveaway
title: Update a giveaway
